# Changelog: the newest release

Source: <https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/changelog>

## 1 October 2026

- An allocation the broker books without writing our reference back is `booked`. Before, it was `uncertain` until our operations team settled it.
- A trade, a position or an order's fill that the broker writes with a quantity such as `1.0` is read as that many shares. Before, the read answered `502 exchange_error`, and a fill written so left the order `pending`.
- Orders the sandbox rejected before this release as a limit order on a share keep `reject_reason` `limit_orders_etf_only`. No order is rejected with it now; the API reference and the [error page](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/errors) list it as retired.
- **For generated clients:** every endpoint in the API reference has a `default` response, the shared `ErrorResponse`: what any path can answer besides the codes it lists, such as `404 not_found` for a path that doesn't exist. A client generated from the reference now has a type for it. Requests and responses are unchanged.
- **Breaking:** the broker takes limit orders on shares, and only limit orders on an ETF. A market order on an ETF is rejected with `reject_reason` `etf_limit_orders_only`, which replaces `limit_orders_etf_only`: send a limit order. A limit order on a share, rejected before, is now placed. See [Order types](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/orders#order-types).
- A market order, and a market order's estimate, no longer fails with `503 exchange_unavailable` when the broker's price list has an unreadable row for another symbol. Only an order whose own symbol has no readable price limit is refused, and nothing is sent.
- `GET /v1/accounts/{account}/contract-notes` has five new figures, `amount_kobo_decimal`, `commission_kobo_decimal`, `statutory_fees_kobo_decimal`, `other_fees_kobo_decimal` and `consideration_kobo_decimal`: each the broker's figure exact, in kobo, as a decimal string. The whole-kobo figures stay, rounded against the customer: the three charges up, and `amount_kobo` and `consideration_kobo` up on a buy and down on a sell. See [After a fill](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/orders#after-a-fill).
- The broker keeps cash and charges to fractions of a kobo. `GET /v1/accounts/{account}/balance` has three new figures, `opening_kobo_decimal`, `pending_debits_kobo_decimal` and `available_kobo_decimal`, and `POST /v1/orders/estimate` has `estimated_total_kobo_decimal`: each the broker's figure exact, in kobo, as a decimal string. The whole-kobo figures stay, rounded so that what an account can spend is never overstated: `opening_kobo` and `available_kobo` round down, `pending_debits_kobo` rounds up, and `estimated_total_kobo` rounds up for a buy and down for a sell. Before, a figure finer than a kobo was refused with `502 exchange_error`, or `503 exchange_unavailable` for an estimate; the sandbox rounded an estimate to the nearest kobo. See [Estimate the order](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/trade#2-estimate-the-order).
- Send an application's four documents, a passport photograph, a government-issued ID, a utility bill and a signature, with [`PUT /v1/applications/{id}/documents/{type}`](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/applications#send-the-documents), the file itself as the body. It needs the `apply` scope and counts toward your requests in progress at once. New codes: `document_too_large`, `invalid_document`, `application_not_accepting_documents`, `document_already_delivered`, `document_in_flight`, `earlier_document_unconfirmed`, `document_unconfirmed` and `document_rejected`. [Keep your customers' data](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/keys-and-security#your-customers-data) lists what we keep of each document: never the file. The broker has all four, and the application becomes `submitted`. In the sandbox, an application opens once its four documents arrive, or at our next check after its broker restarts.
- **Breaking:** `phone` and `next_of_kin_phone` on [`POST /v1/applications`](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/applications) must be Nigerian numbers: `0` and 10 digits, or `+234` and the same 10 digits. We send them to the broker as `0` and 10 digits, which the broker asks for. Any other number is refused with `400 invalid_request`, `param` naming the field, and nothing is sent to the broker. The refusal doesn't store your key.
- **Breaking:** an application the broker takes is `documents_required`, not `submitted`, with an `application.documents_required` event: the broker needs the customer's four documents (a photo, a government-issued ID, a utility bill and a signature) before its staff can review it. `submitted` now means the broker has the application and its documents. Applications already `submitted` stay so. See [Application states](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/applications#application-states).
- We keep asking the broker about an application waiting for its account until it opens or our operations team records its outcome, at every check for its first 5 minutes, then less often, and at least once an hour. Before, we stopped after a month. While the broker reviews it, a status it gives that we can read, whatever its words, leaves the application waiting, `documents_required` or `submitted`. See [Wait for the account to open](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/applications#4-wait-for-the-account-to-open).
- An application waiting for its account can become `uncertain`: when the broker says, at least 10 minutes after the application last changed state and twice with the same answer, that it holds no application under its reference, or gives no account and a status we can't read. Our operations team reconciles it: it becomes `documents_required` again, or `submitted` when the broker has its four documents, with that event again, or `unplaced`. Handle `uncertain` after either, and the event repeated. See [Applications](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/applications#4-wait-for-the-account-to-open).
- **Breaking:** `mothers_maiden_name` is required on [`POST /v1/applications`](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/applications). An application without it is refused with `400 missing_required_field`, `param` `mothers_maiden_name`, and nothing is sent to the broker. It applies from this release, in the sandbox as in live, with no version to pin. Applications already sent are unaffected. The refusal doesn't store your key, so add the field and send the request again with the same `Idempotency-Key`. The broker's document marks the field optional, but the broker refuses an application without one.
- Your partner portal's Administrators create, rotate and revoke your API keys, at any hour, without asking us. The portal creates a key, or rotates one with an overlap, only while your company holds fewer than 10 working keys; past that it answers [`too_many_keys`](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/errors#too_many_keys), and nothing changes. See [Keys and security](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/keys-and-security#how-keys-are-created).
- Money in your wallet can be taken out to your company's bank account. Your partner portal's Administrators set the payout account and ask for each withdrawal in the portal. See [Take money out](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/wallet#from-your-wallet).
- **Breaking:** `GET /v1/wallet` has two new figures: `withdrawing_kobo`, the amount held for withdrawals not yet paid, and `withdrawn_kobo`, the amount paid out less any your bank sent back. `available_kobo` now equals `credited_kobo` minus `allocated_kobo`, `reserved_kobo`, `withdrawing_kobo` and `withdrawn_kobo`: if you check the old equation, add the two new figures. See [The figures](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/wallet#the-figures).
- `GET /v1/wallet/transfers` has four new entry types, `withdrawal_held`, `withdrawal_paid`, `withdrawal_released` and `withdrawal_returned`, and a new field on every entry, `withdrawal`, naming the withdrawal it belongs to. `allocation` is null on the four new types, as on a `credit`: tell entries apart by `type`, never by a null `allocation`. See [Read the ledger](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/wallet#read-the-ledger).
- A wrong method on `/v1/orders/estimate` answers `405 method_not_allowed` naming `POST`. It named `GET, DELETE`, and `GET` and `DELETE` answered `404 order_not_found`.
- The API reference says a cursor and each required text field of an application can't be empty. The gateway already refused both with `400`.
- The API reference's server is the sandbox's address, so a client generated from it calls the sandbox. The live host comes with your live keys.
- Each endpoint's description in the API reference ends with the [scope](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/keys-and-security#scopes) its key needs, as its security requirement already said.
- The API reference defines `side`, `type` and `time_in_force` once, as `OrderSide`, `OrderType` and `TimeInForce`, and gives every other list of values a title, so a client generated from it has one type for each. Requests and responses are unchanged.
- The API reference describes each request body and each object, shows an example of each shared header, and lists each endpoint's responses by status.
- **For generated clients:** each shared parameter, request body, response and header in the API reference ends its name with its kind, such as `AccountParameter` and `AccountListResponse`, so no two share a name. oapi-codegen now generates a Go client with its default settings. If you generated a client before, regenerate it: those types have new names. Requests and responses are unchanged.
- The [quickstart](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/quickstart) gives the sandbox's address, and the Postman sandbox environment has it filled in as `base_url`. We no longer send it with your sandbox key. The live host comes with your live keys.
